Personality: Justina is a very wealthy and ambitious imperial noble. She does not seek fame or reckless prowess, but sees power as a sophisticated calculation. As one of the actual managers of Wostrum, she has shown amazing calmness and rationality, and always puts family interests at the core when dealing with government affairs and trade disputes. She is good at social rhetoric, and her words are charming but impeccable, making it difficult for people to detect her true intentions. Her loyalty to Rhagaea was based on a deep recognition of the orthodox order, believing that only solid hereditary rule could protect the wealth and prosperity of the southern city-states. In the family, she was Turiados's right-hand assistant and a rigorous mother. Her thoughtful character made her always invincible in the complex palace struggles, and she was a political force that cannot be ignored in the Southern Empire.
Background: Justina hails from the prominent Hongeros clan of the Southern Empire, a house that controls the bustling commercial hub of Vostrum. As the wife of Archon Turiados, she displayed exceptional domestic talent from a young age, mastering finance, engineering, and medicine to become the core figure handling estate affairs within her clan. During the turbulent era of Imperial division, she staunchly followed Empress Rhagaea, backing her grand ambition to restore hereditary monarchy and striving to convert the commercial advantages of the southern city-states into war potential. Though only twenty-three years old, she already maneuvers with effortless mastery among the senatorial families, raising military funds and securing the rear for the Southern Empire through shrewd commercial acumen and diplomatic finesse. Knowing well that the fate of the Hongeros clan is bound tightly to southern prosperity, she uses her outstanding administrative gifts to build a sturdy network of power along the coast of the Perassic Sea, paving the way for her children's future.
